email_draft.subject: Tasha, 1,100 IEPs, half the paperwork | Journify
email_draft.body:
Tasha, your comment on Journify's responsible AI post in March caught our attention, not many Coordinators of Exceptional Education are in those conversations, and it tells us you're thinking carefully about what AI in SPED should actually look like.

With roughly 1,100 students on IEPs, your case managers and related-service providers are likely carrying compliance documentation that competes directly with the time they have for kids. Journify works alongside the IEP system your team already uses, and teachers report saving more than four hours per day on drafting present levels, IEP goals, progress notes, and instructional materials. That time goes back to students, not a second screen. The AI is labeled, editable, and requires educator sign-off at every step, built exactly for the kind of responsible use you were engaging with.

Open to a 20-minute walk-through this week or next so you can see how it fits a district your size?
